name: text-reveal
title: Text reveal
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Reveals a short line word by word on mount, or ties each word's opacity to scroll. Reduced motion shows the plain text.

meta.descriptionEs: Revela una frase corta palabra por palabra, al montarse o con el scroll. Con movimiento reducido el texto está visible desde el inicio.

api.name: text
api.description: Copy. A newline starts another line.

api.name: trigger
api.description: mount plays once. scroll ties each word to the viewport. Default mount.

api.name: delay
api.description: Seconds before the first word, when trigger is mount. Default 0.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT) for the mount reveal. The scroll trigger is clean-room: each word fades from about 0.2 to 1 with animation-timeline view() and animation-range entry 20% cover 50% when the browser supports it, and use-scroll-progress otherwise. If progress is not a number, the word stays fully visible. Words are aria-hidden. A screen-reader span keeps the full sentence. Reduced motion, including motion-preference, shows the text at full opacity. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite use-scroll-progress, motion-preference, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion UI and Motion+ are not included.
